scopeNotes: Bounded extraction only; this is not a complete Daikin consumer range.

The existing Perfera staging candidate is preserved unchanged. This supplement records class identity only because the pinned catalogue HTML flattens merged physical table cells and no page image has been pinned for visual column review.
Siesta exact ATXC-E and ARXC-E full references, physical rows and class pairing are published in current Daikin Europe sources; sales availability in France remains unknown.
No nominal capacity, power input, refrigerant charge, capacity class, or inferred UA data included.
Heating fan airflow remains separate from cooling airflow and is omitted here; the source table documents cooling high airflow only.
